## Read the data, credit data

```{r}
# data files live in data/ (run from the repository root)
df <-read.csv('CreditRisk_RiskSimulator_moodle_R_csv_CL.csv',sep=';',dec='.')
head(df)
```

Let's use caret to partition the data 70/30
```{r}
library(caret)
set.seed(123)
d <- createDataPartition(df$Incumplimiento,p=0.7,list=FALSE)
train <- df[d,]
test <- df[-d,]
table(train$Incumplimiento)


```
```{r}
if (!require("ROSE")) install.packages("ROSE"); library(ROSE)

#oversampling and undersampling
over <- ovun.sample(Incumplimiento~.,data=train,N=nrow(train),p=0.5,seed=123,method="both")$data
table(over$Incumplimiento)

```
```{r}
#over sampling only 
over2 <- ovun.sample(Incumplimiento~.,data=train,p=0.5,seed=123,method="over")$data
table(over2$Incumplimiento)
```
```{r}
#Under sampling 
over3 <- ovun.sample(Incumplimiento~.,data=train,p=0.5,seed=123,method="under")$data
table(over3$Incumplimiento)
```
```{r}
##Creating dummy variables with caret 
library(tidyverse)
glimpse(df)
```
```{r}
summary(train$Edad)
```
```{r}
toy_df <- as.data.frame(train$Edad)
colnames(toy_df) <- 'Edad'
head(toy_df)
```
```{r}
##Create ranges
toy_df=toy_df%>%
  mutate(
    Grupo_edades=case_when(
      Edad<=25~"u25",
      Edad>25&Edad<=35~"o25u35",
      Edad>35&Edad<=45~"o35u45",
      Edad>45&Edad<=55~"o45u55",
      Edad>55~"o55"
    )
  )

head(toy_df)
```

```{r}
#encoding the "grupo:edades" variable / column
dmy <- dummyVars("~Grupo_edades",data=toy_df)
trsf <- data.frame(predict(dmy,newdata = toy_df))
head(trsf)
```
However, we should take into account that the ranges of the Age variables are ordered 

```{r}
toy_df2=toy_df%>%
  mutate(
    Grupo_edades=case_when(
      Edad<=25~"u25",
      Edad>25&Edad<=35~"o25u35",
      Edad>35&Edad<=45~"o35u45",
      Edad>45&Edad<=55~"o45u55",
      Edad>55~"o55"
    ),
    #convert to a factor
    Grupo_edades=factor(
      Grupo_edades,
      order=TRUE,
      level=c("u25","o25u35","o35u45","o45u55","o55")
    )
  )
str(toy_df2)
levels(toy_df2$Grupo_edades)
head(toy_df2)
```
